steps.title: Epidermal Clearing
steps.description: The skin surface is meticulously cleansed and prepared using medical-grade formulations to ensure zero barrier interference.

steps.title: Pathway Micro-Channels
steps.description: Microscopic pathways are gently opened in the dermis, setting up the structural guide channels for deep cell permeability.

steps.title: Exosome Influx
steps.description: Pure, clinical-grade signaling exosomes are introduced, delivering growth factors and signaling lipids directly to the deep dermal matrix.

steps.title: Cellular Sealing

steps.title: BAP Mapping
steps.description: Meticulous marking of the 5 key Bio Aesthetic Points (BAP) on each side of the face to optimize dermal diffusion.

steps.title: Micro-Targeted Delivery
steps.description: Ultra-pure hyaluronic acid is precisely injected at calibrated depths into each designated BAP site with minimal discomfort.

steps.title: Dynamic Hydration Diffusion
steps.description: The dual-weight hyaluronic acid complex begins to slowly diffuse evenly across the surrounding skin tissues.

steps.title: Bio-Remodeling Cycle
steps.description: Continuous stimulation of 4 distinct collagen and elastin types, progressively lifting and remodeling sagging skin tissue.

steps.title: Subdermal Mapping
steps.description: Calibrating needle penetration depths (ranging from 1mm to 4mm) to target the specific thickness of skin and localized fat.

steps.title: Micro-Needle Penetration
steps.description: Gold-plated microneedles gently enter the skin to the exact pre-calibrated depth to deliver subdermal energy.

steps.title: RF Coagulation & Contraction
steps.description: Radiofrequency energy pulses through the needle tips, heating and remodeling subdermal adipose tissue and contracting fibers.

steps.title: Neocollagenesis Trigger
steps.description: Immediate contraction coupled with long-term collagen building results in a tighter, contoured, and lifted facial structure.

steps.title: Precision Volumization
steps.description: Delicate dermal sculpting to fill vertical lines, restore proportional volume, and define natural borders.

steps.title: Hydration Integration
steps.description: The hyaluronic gel integrates with the lip tissue, locking in deep moisture for a soft, lush, and hydrated pout.

steps.title: Vector Mapping
steps.description: Charting gluteal contours, highlighting hip dips, and mapping target vectors for optimal projection and lift.

steps.description: Administering high-density poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) bio-stimulator gel into the deep subcutaneous adipose layers.

steps.description: Using specialized manual massage techniques to distribute the micro-particles evenly for perfectly smooth contours.

steps.title: Sustained Collagenesis
steps.description: The bio-stimulating particles trigger gradual, long-term collagen building, filling and rounding contours over 4-6 weeks.

steps.title: Laxity Mapping
steps.description: Analyzing excess upper or lower eyelid skin and marking the micro-contraction guide path for exact sublimation.

steps.title: Plasma Arc Application
steps.description: A precision device creates focused plasma energy points, instantly sublimating the outermost epidermal layer.

steps.title: Immediate Contraction
steps.description: The plasma micro-arcs trigger immediate shrinkage of loose skin cells, tightening drooping tissue with zero bleeding.

steps.title: Epidermal Re-Surfacing
steps.description: Micro-crusts form and naturally shed over 5-7 days, revealing fresh, remarkably tightened, and lifted eyelid skin.

steps.description: Identifying localized, stubborn fat pockets (such as double chins or love handles) and marking a precise grid guide.

steps.title: Lipolytic Infusion
steps.description: Injecting the specialized Aqualyx deoxycholic acid formula directly into the center of the subcutaneous fat layer.

steps.title: Membrane Liquefaction
steps.description: The formulation dissolves the rigid lipid membranes, safely breaking down and liquefying target fat cells.

steps.title: Metabolic Clearance
steps.description: The lymphatic system naturally processes and permanently flushes the dissolved fat lipids out of your body.
